title: The television version of the quadrille was not the real thing
summary: They discuss a brief TV broadcast of the quadrille that did not use his music, and his dealings with the station about it.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Well what you saw on television was not the real thing at all. Not the real thing. And it wasn't the music either because I had...
No, Paul Barberin tried to arrange something for her.
Well they played to arrange something but that wasn't the music at all.

Because I had the music here and I had this copywriter. And that's where she wanted to take the thing in charge. And when I explained to the WDSU, Mr. who was in charge then? The poor fellow that apprehended the commons or something.
Boy I remember his name begins with L. I can't remember now what it was. Liberalite.
